transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Morning. Hello? Can you guys hear me? Okay. Lin, first, how did the weekend run go?

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: It completed. Both samples made it through without a fault. I did see a bit of drift in the encoder reading near the end.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: OK. Also, load pad, we need 12 by 10/8. Zoe, is that still the plan for the compression rig?

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: yeah. i havent heard from anyone on it tho. ill check email, there might be something from fri

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: i can do a dry run on the rig w/o the pad but the load wont spread right

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: No. Don't. We'd learn nothing.

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: ok. makes sense

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Where did the spare dowel pins go? I had a bag of them on the bench and now it's gone!!

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: I moved them to the drawer. Left side, second one down.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Thank you. Next time put a note.

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: hey sorry im late, scooter battery died

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: No worries. Luis, did you get the fan shroud fixed?

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: started, the one corner is cracked more than i thought, so i might need to remake it

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: *remake the whole thing

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Fine, do whatever's faster.

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Hi!! Sorry, the bus 😬 What did I miss 🙏

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Nothing big. Status on the assembly?

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Second unit is built, I'm torquing the last fasteners today. The cable clamp was a pain 😬

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: I told them that clamp was too tight. We need to open it up a bit!!

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: i also found the stripped thread on the fixture plate, i helicoil it today. should be good by eow

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: OK. Let's wrap up. Thanks.
